pii_python_missing: Python not found ({python}). Set JGATES_PYTHON or put Python on the PATH.
pii_sidecar_missing: The quality-gate package (sidecar) was not found.
pii_condition: Searches the target's text files for the enabled entities (CPF, CNPJ and credit card by default; phone when enabled); the value found is never stored.
pii_limitation: The detector only observes: it does not fix content and only recognizes the pt-BR format. An option it does not support is refused, never ignored.
pii_blocked: The PII detector could not run: {detail}
pii_no_invocation: The plan has no PII detector invocation for the instance {tool}.
pii_timeout: The PII detector exceeded the limit of {seconds} s and was ended.
pii_exit_error: The PII detector ended with code {code}: {detail}
pii_invalid_output: The PII detector answer does not have the expected format: {detail}
pii_bridge_error: The PII detector refused the request ({code}): {message}
pii_route_entity_unsupported: The entity {entity} has no detector; there is nothing to turn on ({path}).
pii_route_bad_severity: {path} accepts low, medium, high or critical.
pii_route_locale_unsupported: The built-in detector only recognizes the format {locales}; {path} cannot change.
pii_route_redact_unsupported: The built-in detector never shows the value found; {path} can only stay on.
pii_route_remediation_unsupported: The built-in detector only observes: fixing content is not available ({path}).
pii_route_conflict: pii.yml changed since the screen read it.
pii_route_conflict_fix: Reload the screen and redo the change.
pii_entity_skipped: The entity {entity} was left out for this run only (--skip); pii.yml did not change.
pii_cmd_description: Checks and fixes personal data in the project files: check detects and changes nothing; fix corrects through the tools of .jgates/pii.yml (fix.tools), with a preview, confirmation and --undo.
pii_cmd_option_staged: Only what is in the Git index; fix refuses a file with changes outside the index and puts the fixed files back in the index.
pii_cmd_option_changed: Only the changed tracked files (staged or not).
pii_cmd_option_all: Every file of the project (tracked and untracked, not ignored).
pii_cmd_option_dry_run: fix: shows what would change and changes nothing.
pii_cmd_option_diff: fix: shows the diff on the terminal (never written to a log or a result).
pii_cmd_option_undo: fix: restores the originals of a fix (the newest one, or the fix id given).
pii_cmd_usage_fix: Use: jgates pii check [--staged | --changed | --all | <paths>] or jgates pii fix [same scope] [--dry-run] [--diff] [--yes] | --undo [<fixId>]
pii_cmd_fix_only_option: {name} is an option of jgates pii fix.
pii_cmd_undo_with_options: --undo takes only the fix id: no scope, --dry-run, --diff or --yes.
pii_cmd_bad_fix_id: {id} is not a fix id (for example 20261027T120000Z-a1b2c3).
pii_cmd_scope_conflict: Choose one scope only: --staged, --changed, --all or paths.
pii_cmd_diff_json: --diff shows the change on the terminal only and does not go with --json.
pii_cmd_config_invalid_fix: Fix the fields named above (jgates config validate shows every problem) and run again.
pii_cmd_not_git: {path} is not in a Git repository: the default scope, --staged and --changed need Git.
pii_cmd_git_failed_fix: Check the repository with git status and run again.
pii_cmd_path_outside_fix: Name paths inside the project, or use --cwd.
pii_cmd_no_tool: The built-in detector only detects; jgates pii fix corrects through a tool named in fix.tools of .jgates/pii.yml, and none is configured. Nothing was changed.
pii_cmd_no_tool_fix: Define the tool under tools and name it in fix.tools (see the security page of the documentation), or fix the files by hand after jgates pii check.
pii_cmd_nothing_to_undo: There is no fix to undo in this project (the originals are kept for a few days only).
pii_cmd_nothing_to_undo_fix: jgates pii fix --undo restores only fixes made by jgates pii fix that have not expired.
pii_cmd_fix_not_found: The fix {id} was not found in this project (it may have expired or already been undone).
pii_cmd_fix_not_found_fix: Run jgates pii fix --undo without an id to restore the newest fix.
pii_cmd_text_incomplete: The check is incomplete: a detector did not complete.
pii_cmd_text_fix_hint: The values are not shown. To correct them with the configured tools: jgates pii fix
pii_cmd_text_tool_failed: Nothing was applied: the correction cannot be trusted ({code}). {reason}
pii_cmd_text_needs_yes: Nothing was changed: confirm on a terminal or use --yes.
pii_cmd_text_applied: {count} file(s) changed. The originals are kept until {expires}: jgates pii fix --undo {id}
pii_cmd_text_staged_again: The changed files went back to the index.
pii_cmd_text_stage_failed: git add of the changed files failed: {detail}
pii_cmd_text_history: The fix does not clean the Git history: a value already committed stays in the earlier commits (see git filter-repo).
pii_gc_text_pending: {count} expired pii fix original(s) would be deleted ({bytes} bytes).
pii_gc_text_removed: {count} expired pii fix original(s) deleted ({bytes} bytes).
